description: List a website's page URLs from its sitemap, navigation, or a browser render. Use this to see what exists on a site before deciding what to capture. Honest failure fields pass through: `blocked: true` means a bot wall refused the browser at the door; `redirectsTo` means the site lives at a different host; `hadSitemap: false` with few urls means the site genuinely offers no map.

url.description: The site to map, e.g. 'stripe.com' or a full URL.

name: map_site
title: Map a site's pages
